subject: Atlas Retail POC — ops alignment & sprint-0 setup
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Miriam Patel <miriam.patel@atlas-retail.com>, Ethan Zhou <e.zhou@atlas-retail.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-07-19T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Atlas Retail POC — ops alignment & sprint-0 setup

Hi Miriam / Ethan —

Thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap from our discovery that I wanted to capture and confirm so we have a shared starting point for the POC kickoff:

Summary of pain points you shared
- Search/product title generation has variable quality across categories (clothing vs home goods).
- At peak traffic (holiday spikes) inference latency frequently exceeds 600ms which negatively impacts UX.
- Current costs for candidate generation are material at scale; you mentioned wanting to bring inference unit cost down by ~30%.

Goals for the 4-week POC we discussed
- 95th percentile response latency < 200ms for the interactive endpoint (target region us-east-1).
- Reduce inference unit cost by at least 25–35% versus current baseline.
- Establish a reproducible prompt + eval suite (30 canonical prompts per use case) and a pass/fail quality gate.

Proposed POC scope (high level)
- Sprint-0 (week 0): environment provisioning, access, and baseline perf measurements.
- Sprint-1 (weeks 1–2): model/quantization experiments + workload shaping, prefix/KV caching tests.
- Sprint-2 (weeks 3–4): integration with your QA prompts, latency tuning, and final acceptance run.

Owners & initial asks
- Atlas: Miriam (product) / Ethan (engineering) — provide sample dataset, credentials for a read-only S3 bucket, and a staging API endpoint.
- Redwood: Laura (AE) — engagement lead; Aditya (solutions) — technical onboarding & evals; Ben (CS) — production readiness & runbook.

Access/setup checklist (attachments: sprint0-access-checklist.pdf)
- Create read-only S3 bucket access for redwood-poc@atlas-retail (see checklist).
- Provide a list of sample product categories + a 1k sample file (CSV) for prompt tuning.
- Approve a kickoff for week of 7/26 (open to moving earlier if needed).

Acceptance criteria (to be refined in kickoff)
- Functional correctness: >=85% on the prompt eval suite (subjective pass/fail reviewed by Atlas product).
- Performance: 95p latency <200ms under 50 RPS synthetic load for the use-case path.
- Cost: demonstration of cost reduction strategies producing >=25% unit cost decrease in the experimental runs.

I attached the access checklist and a starter prompt-eval examples file. Please reply with any corrections to the scope above and confirm whether 7/26 works for a formal kickoff.

Thanks — looking forward to getting momentum on this.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0134

Attachments: sprint0-access-checklist.pdf, prompt-eval-examples.json

From: Miriam Patel <miriam.patel@atlas-retail.com>

Laura —

Thanks for the clear summary, this matches our internal notes. A few additions from our side:

- Legal has asked for a high-level data retention and access control summary up front (SOC2 status would be helpful; a short pointer to the controls we can expect during the POC).
- For the sample data, can we include a small set of historical queries tied to product IDs? That will make the prompt evals more realistic.
- 7/26 looks good for kickoff; can we aim for 11:00 AM PT?

I looped Ethan on the bucket details; he can drop the S3 ARN later today.

Miriam

Miriam / Ethan —

Perfect — appreciate the quick reply. Confirming the kickoff: Tuesday 7/26 at 11:00 AM PT (calendar invite to follow). Below is a more detailed kickoff agenda and the immediate pre-kickoff asks so your team can prepare:

Kickoff agenda (30–45m)- Introductions & success criteria (5min)
- Baseline measurement plan & data handoff (10min)
- Environment & access review (10min)
- Sprint cadence & owners (5min)
- Qs / next steps (remaining)

Immediate pre-kickoff checklist (please complete by 7/23)
- S3 read-only ARN for sample data (Ethan) — we only need read-only list + 1k sample CSV.
- List of 30 priority prompts / evaluation cases (Miriam) — if you prefer, we can use our starter set and iterate.
- Any legal/compliance pointers (SOC2 summary link or contact) so I can bring our security lead to the kickoff.

POC kickoff deliverables (we will send separate artifacts after kickoff)
- Mutual action plan (MAM) with milestone dates and owners — template attached (atlas-poc-mam link will be posted to HubSpot).
- A prompt-eval repo (30 canonical prompts with expected outputs + scoring rubric).
- Baseline perf and cost snapshot captured during sprint-0.

Environment & access notes (technical)
- Redwood requires a dedicated service account (IAM role) with S3 read access for the sample set and permission to call the staging API endpoint. If you prefer, we can accept a short-lived access token for the initial run.
- For network/reachability: please confirm whether the staging endpoint sits behind an IP allowlist, and provide a contact to add our test worker IPs.

Attachments included: sprint0-access-checklist.pdf, atlas-poc-success-metrics.xlsx, prompt-eval-examples.json

If anything above looks off, flag it now and I'll update before the invite. Otherwise I'll issue the calendar invite and share the MAM template in HubSpot.

Thanks — see you on 7/26.

Best,
Laura
